children: Goodtech continues to strengthen its position as a leading supplier of automation and digitalization solutions to the feed industry through a new contract award from a leading international aquafeed producer.

Goodtech has been awarded a contract to deliver a significant digital systems upgrade for a production facility in Norway. The project will improve production flow control, strengthen data integration and provide the infrastructure required for advanced operational data management.
The upgrade will replace aging technology and discontinued components, ensuring long-term maintainability and access to modern software, hardware and engineering resources.

Under the contract, Goodtech will deliver advanced supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA), programmable logic controller (PLC) and manufacturing execution system (MES) solutions. The upgrade will improve access to spare parts and engineering expertise while providing a platform for further improvements in equipment uptime, product quality and operational performance.

"We are proud that the customer has selected Goodtech as its trusted partner for an important digitalization project," said Margrethe Hauge, CEO of Goodtech. "The award demonstrates our strong position within the feed and food industry and highlights our capability to deliver advanced industrial IT and automation solutions that support our customers' long-term competitiveness, efficiency and sustainability goals."
The contract has a value in the range of NOK 20-30 million. The project will commence in September 2026 and is expected to be completed by April 2027.

title: Goodtech awarded digital upgrade contract
